title: Resin to Amber
description: Renames and replaces Resin into Amber
body:
24w14potato Added Amber to the game, and then they added weird orange tree sap resin bricks instead and so I felt like righting that wrong!

This pack replaces the texture of the resin bricks to the Amber gem (which itself was a recoloured ruby) from the april fools snapshot with an updated look and renames resin items to "Amber"

I also made this pack for another reason, but thats for you to figure out <3
